verdict.rationale: An AI insights feature is a fair thing to ask of a business account and payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Wise Business generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The llms.txt probe only makes the docs readable by LLMs, and statement exports in CSV, XLSX and similar formats would let a user analyse data with outside tools; neither is an in-product AI capability.
